objective.en: Find the hardest-hit snow areas after the January 2022 nor'easter so crews can clear roads to hospitals.

sources.name: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation rate (GIBS layer IMERG_Precipitation_Rate) + NASA Terra MODIS NDSI snow cover (GIBS layer MODIS_Terra_NDSI_Snow_Cover)
sources.usage: Hazard cells = top 20% of storm-total GPM IMERG precipitation during the 28-29 January 2022 nor'easter blizzard, kept only where Terra MODIS NDSI shows snow on the ground afterwards (2022-01-29..2022-01-30 (IMERG), 2022-01-30..2022-02-01 (MODIS)). eventDay = day a cell received a quarter of its storm total. The hazard cut-off is a game choice.

sources.name: Mission: Possible cloud and detectability model
sources.usage: cloudProbability (baseline 0.5 for this snow setting) and detectability are seeded educational estimates, not observations.
